data.description: LLM-Review advisory on S2 (438a-e1d9-29d3-4081, patchset 4, tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_status_mapping.py:129): the process-global _DRIFT_WARNED set in adapters/jira_family/outbound_mapper.py is reset only by test_drift_warning_deduped_within_pass (at its start), not by an autouse fixture. Tests that assert a drift warning IS emitted (e.g. test_unmapped_status_drifts) can be polluted under reordering if an earlier test already recorded the same status. Non-manifesting today (CI runs the full suite green in definition order), purely defensive. Fix: add an autouse fixture calling outbound_mapper.reset_drift_warnings() before each test in the module. Test-only, behavior-preserving. Filed for follow-up.
data.title: Add autouse fixture resetting _DRIFT_WARNED for status-mapping tests
